title: Niche dating app
summary: A dating app for a specific group or with a new matching twist.
whyTempting: Everyone hates dating apps and has an idea to fix them.
whyItFails: Liquidity. Niches lack enough local matches. Success means churn. Happy couples leave. Incumbents copy features. Large apps add your twist.
whatWouldChange: Communities that already exist offline and can bring density from day one.

attempts.notes: Selective dating app for career-focused singles.

reasons.detail: Liquidity: Niches lack enough local matches.
Success means churn: Happy couples leave.
